content.text: If you're a digital creator in a country where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-2|stripe]] is not available, or a PayPal account suspension is looming, your infrastructure options are limited to using a platform that may suspend or restrict your sales at any time. One that doesn't rely on Stripe or any other external [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-honest-side-side|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processor?

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

When considering alternatives to Stripe or other platform restrictions, it's essential to understand what each option actually offers. Gumroad, for instance, provides a simple and user-friendly interface for selling digital products, but it comes with a 3.5% payment processing fee. Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, offers more advanced features, such as customizable storefronts and email marketing tools, but it also requires a Stripe or PayPal account for payment processing. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This means you can sell digital products without relying on Stripe or any other external payment processor.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to handling restricted countries, most platforms will either block or restrict access to their services. Gumroad, for example, explicitly states that it doesn't support sales in countries where Stripe or PayPal is restricted. Lemon Squeezy also requires a Stripe or PayPal account for payment processing, which can be problematic in restricted countries. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to work in countries where Stripe or PayPal is not available, making it an ideal solution for digital creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are essential considerations when choosing a payment processor. Gumroad's payment processing fee is 3.5%, which can add up quickly. Lemon Squeezy's fees are also relatively high, especially if you're using a Stripe or PayPal account for payment processing. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which comes with a 0.5% fee. This can result in significant cost savings compared to using a traditional payment processor.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are critical aspects of a sovereign commerce infrastructure. With Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you have complete control over your sales, delivery, and data. You can automate workflows, set up email marketing campaigns, and deliver products to customers without relying on a platform. In contrast, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy require you to rely on their infrastructure and services, which can be limiting and restrictive.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the architecture you choose will depend on your specific situation and needs. If you're looking for a simple and user-friendly solution, Gumroad may be a good choice. However, if you need more advanced features and flexibility, Lemon Squeezy may be a better option. But if you want a sovereign commerce infrastructure that gives you complete control over your sales, delivery, and data, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the clear winner. With its complete commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can build a business that is truly yours.
